selected_blocks.text: Similar to slicing presets, you can set up custom Racks for converting Harmony, Melody, or Drums to MIDI.
selected_blocks.raw_html: Similar to slicing presets, you can set up custom Racks for converting Harmony, Melody, or Drums to MIDI.

selected_blocks.text: It is recommended to use an Instrument Rack for the Harmony and Melody conversions, that way you can add MIDI and audio effects to the device chain. However, it is also possible to use a single instrument on its own if desired. The Drums to MIDI conversion requires a Drum Rack with Sampler or Simpler devices on its pads.
selected_blocks.raw_html: It is recommended to use an Instrument Rack for the Harmony and Melody conversions, that way you can add MIDI and audio effects to the device chain. However, it is also possible to use a single instrument on its own if desired. The Drums to MIDI conversion requires a Drum Rack with Sampler or Simpler devices on its pads.

selected_blocks.text: Add the devices you want to use to the Instrument Rack (if using one), or add the drum hits you want included in the Drum Rack. Adjust the device parameters and map them to the Macro Controls as needed. Drag the configured device or Rack into one of the three Audio to MIDI folders: Drums to MIDI, Harmony to MIDI, or Melody to MIDI to save it as a default.
selected_blocks.raw_html: Add the devices you want to use to the Instrument Rack (if using one), or add the drum hits you want included in the Drum Rack. Adjust the device parameters and map them to the Macro Controls as needed. Drag the configured device or Rack into one of the three Audio to MIDI folders: Drums to MIDI, Harmony to MIDI, or Melody to MIDI to save it as a default.

selected_blocks.text: You can also drag an existing device or Rack preset into the conversion folders instead of creating one from scratch. Make sure to only add a Drum Rack to the Drums to MIDI folder, and not a Drum Rack nested in an Instrument Rack; otherwise, the preset will not be recognized as a default.

Make sure to only add a Drum Rack to the Drums to MIDI folder, and not a Drum Rack nested in an Instrument Rack; otherwise, the preset will not be recognized as a default.

selected_blocks.text: After the default is saved, it will be used any time you run its corresponding conversion command.
selected_blocks.raw_html: After the default is saved, it will be used any time you run its corresponding conversion command.

selected_blocks.text: Note that while it is possible to add multiple presets to the same conversion folder, only one default can be used at a time. When running the conversion command, the preset that was last added to the folder is used.
